```{=html}
<script>
/* Schedule enhancers: type pills + due chips. Does not change content. */
(function () {
  if (!document.body.classList.contains("schedule-page")) return;

  function pillClass(text) {
    var t = (text || "").toLowerCase();
    if (t.indexOf("midterm") !== -1) return "sch-pill sch-pill-exam";
    if (t.indexOf("quiz") !== -1 && t.indexOf("lab") !== -1) return "sch-pill sch-pill-quiz";
    if (t.indexOf("lab") !== -1) return "sch-pill sch-pill-lab";
    if (t.indexOf("async") !== -1) return "sch-pill sch-pill-async";
    if (t.indexOf("review") !== -1) return "sch-pill sch-pill-review";
    if (t.indexOf("presentation") !== -1) return "sch-pill sch-pill-present";
    if (t.indexOf("studio") !== -1) return "sch-pill sch-pill-studio";
    if (t.indexOf("concept") !== -1) return "sch-pill sch-pill-concepts";
    if (t === "—" || t === "-" || t === "") return "sch-pill sch-pill-mute";
    return "sch-pill sch-pill-default";
  }

  var week = document.getElementById("week-by-week");
  if (week) {
    week.querySelectorAll("table tbody tr").forEach(function (tr) {
      var cells = tr.children;
      if (cells.length < 4) return;
      var typeCell = cells[1];
      var dueCell = cells[3];
      var typeText = typeCell.textContent.trim();
      typeCell.innerHTML = '<span class="' + pillClass(typeText) + '">' + typeCell.innerHTML + "</span>";
      var dueText = dueCell.textContent.trim();
      if (dueText && dueText !== "—") {
        dueCell.innerHTML = '<span class="sch-due">' + dueCell.innerHTML + "</span>";
      } else {
        dueCell.classList.add("sch-due-empty");
      }
      if (/midterm/i.test(typeText) || /midterm/i.test(dueText)) {
        tr.classList.add("sch-row-exam");
      }
    });
  }

  /* Soft card wrap: each week h3 + following table already in section — add class */
  document.querySelectorAll("#week-by-week > section.level3").forEach(function (sec) {
    sec.classList.add("sch-week-card");
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("#quick-reference > section.level3").forEach(function (sec) {
    sec.classList.add("sch-ref-card");
  });
})();
</script>
```
